entries.headline: Yordan Alvarez stayed in the yard
entries.story: Yordan Alvarez went 0-for-4 against Gerrit Cole and the New York Yankees. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 3 times.

entries.headline: Ben Rice came close
entries.story: Ben Rice went 2-for-4 against Hayden Wesneski and the Houston Astros. Closest call was a double in the 6th: "Ben Rice doubles (21) on a sharp line drive to right fielder Cam Smith." The power showed up; the carry did not.
